title: A strategy’s working parts
hook: A toy strategy has three required capabilities. Does the largest capacity total win?

knows: basic arithmetic and the meaning of a percentage
doesNotKnow: Prefer the capability set that completes the whole required chain over the larger sum of isolated capacities.

misconception: Maximizing the sum of capability budgets necessarily maximizes a strategy’s executable output.
objective: Prefer the capability set that completes the whole required chain over the larger sum of isolated capacities.
